answer: A workable design charges newcomers upfront and refunds on merit. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the vine of free entry disappears, the sable of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the crystal case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
